name: aistupidlevel
title: AI Stupid Level
description: AI model leaderboard, drift status and incidents from AI Stupid Level, plus its Smart Router, which sends each request to the top-scoring model.
author: studioplatforms

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.title: Model Leaderboard
commands.subtitle: AI Stupid Level
commands.description: Rank AI models by their AI Stupid Level benchmark scores for coding, reasoning and tool use, with score history and drift status for each model.

commands.name: incidents
commands.title: Model Incidents
commands.subtitle: AI Stupid Level
commands.description: See active and recently resolved incidents: performance drift, service disruptions and provider-wide degradations detected by AI Stupid Level.

commands.name: ask-router
commands.title: Ask Smart Router
commands.subtitle: AI Stupid Level
commands.description: Send a prompt through the AI Stupid Level Smart Router and see which model answered and why. Uses your own provider keys.

preferences.name: dataApiKey
preferences.title: Data API Key
preferences.description: Used by Model Leaderboard and Model Incidents. Create a free key at aistupidlevel.info/account/data-keys.

preferences.name: routerKey
preferences.title: Smart Router Key
preferences.description: Used by Ask Smart Router and the Smart Router models in Raycast AI. Create one at aistupidlevel.info/router/keys.

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Routing Mode
preferences.description: The routing mode Ask Smart Router starts with.

preferences.name: sandbox
preferences.title: Sandbox Mode
preferences.label: Route for real, answer with a mock
preferences.description: Requests are routed as usual, but the answer is a placeholder: no provider is called and nothing is charged. Useful for trying the extension.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
